title: Apple Stock News (Oct 14, 2026): AAPL Rises 0.1% to $341.27
summary: Apple (AAPL) closed at $341.27, up 0.09%, on Oct 13 after a record intraday high of $348.15 as it unveiled its HomeView smart home hub.
body_markdown:
## Why Apple Stock Rose


According to[Moby](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/apple-hits-fresh-time-high-195032172.html) , Apple's move to a fresh all-time high near $350 followed its October 13 product announcements, led by HomeView, a 7-inch touchscreen smart home hub priced at about $300.


The same report listed a $149 HomePod mini 2, a new 4K TV and smart home accessories that work with LG and Schneider Electric devices, and credited part of the rally to new CEO John Ternus, whom it described as more hardware focused than Tim Cook.


The record did not hold into the close. As reported by[The Wall Street Journal](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/f8f4a351-8cd7-38c4-b283-90376d1fe547/d%C3%A9j%C3%A0-vu%3A-apple-toe-touches-%245.html) , "Apple stock just can't hold the $5 trillion level," with the session ending at a $4.98 trillion market value.


Apple also had a legal development on the same day. Per[TechCrunch](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/judge-orders-openai-turn-over-203644748.html) , US District Judge Edward Davila granted Apple expedited access to some OpenAI hiring records in its trade secrets lawsuit, including interview materials involving former Apple employees, and approved depositions of three former Apple staff now at OpenAI.


## AAPL Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- The smart home lineup gives Apple a new hardware category, with HomeView at about $300 and HomePod mini 2 at $149, according to Moby.
- Apple outperformed all three major indices on a down day for the Nasdaq and set a new 52-week high of $348.15.
- The court order lets Apple pursue part of the discovery it sought against OpenAI, per TechCrunch.


### Risks


- Moby questioned whether the new devices will sell, citing growing consumer concern about surveillance and privacy.
- The stock closed only $0.53 above its day low, and the WSJ noted it again failed to hold a $5 trillion valuation.
- The judge denied Apple's broader discovery requests on OpenAI's hardware research for now, according to TechCrunch.
